features.name: Project Setup
features.description: pyproject + deps skeleton, green verification baseline (python -m pytest -q), repo restartable from clean checkout
features.evidence: pyproject.toml + src/memoria; pip install -e . OK; init.ps1 green

features.name: RAG ingest pipeline
features.description: Upload → parse (PDF/Markdown/网页) → chunk → embed → vector store; incremental update including full vector deletion for a removed document (red line: no orphan vectors)

features.name: RAG query with citations
features.description: Hybrid retrieval (vector + rerank, ~100 lines hand-written core) → generation where every answer sentence cites (document, paragraph/chunk)
features.evidence: rag/retrieve.py + rag/answer.py + llm.py; tests/test_rag_answer.py 6 tests pass; 14 passed total

features.name: LLM Wiki structure
features.description: raw/ (read-only) → wiki/ pages with [[双向链接]], index.md, log.md → schema.md writing spec for the LLM
features.evidence: wiki/pages.py (Wiki + extract_links + DEFAULT_SCHEMA_MD); tests/test_wiki_structure.py 7 tests pass; 21 passed total

features.name: Wiki operations: ingest / query / lint
features.description: ingest: read new source, update ~10 related pages; query: read index.md first then deep answer; lint: broken [[links]], orphan pages, contradictions
features.evidence: wiki/ops.py (ingest/query/lint); tests/test_wiki_ops.py 7 tests pass; 28 passed total

features.name: Email classification (two-stage)
features.description: Gmail API pull → rule layer first (验证码/交易 pass-through, NEVER auto-archive — red line) → LLM classify (营销/通知/待办) + one-line summary → marketing archive requires human confirm click, never automatic
features.evidence: mail/{rules,classify,gmail}.py; tests/test_mail_triage.py 6 tests pass; 34 passed total

features.name: LangGraph orchestration
features.description: State graph: intent routing (问答/邮件/ingest), multi-step ingest (读→写多页→更新索引→lint), human-confirm node before any archive. Core retrieval stays hand-written; LangChain only for integrations (vector store connectors, doc loaders)
features.evidence: graph/{state,nodes,graph}.py; tests/test_graph.py 5 tests pass incl. interrupt/resume; 39 passed total

features.name: RAG × Wiki integration
features.description: (1) Dual-write ingest: vectorize AND compile wiki pages from same document; (2) Hybrid query: Wiki index.md first, fall back to vector retrieval for details; (3) Feedback loop: high-quality Q&A archived as wiki synthesis pages, email-derived facts written into wiki
features.evidence: sync.py (dual_ingest/hybrid_answer/archive_qa/archive_fact) + IngestResult.text; tests/test_sync.py 5 tests pass; 44 passed total

features.name: CLI entry
